fieldValues.title: Essay image layout options
fieldValues.decision_question: Which layout options does an image paragraph offer?
fieldValues.context: The owner, 2026-11-08 (vignette 02e02668): 'We don't support image wrap. we may have a basic set of formatting and layout options that might define full width, original size, alignment. Caption.' Precedent consulted: c7d81c5d (a short supported list is cheap to extend later).
fieldValues.friction: Without a fixed set, every layout wish becomes a new control to build and test on touch and keyboard; with none, a small diagram is stretched to full width.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered:
A. Size: full width or original size; alignment: left, centre or right, used only at original size (recommended). For: exactly the owner's list; three of the six combinations collapse, so few cases to test. Against: no intermediate sizes.
B. A also with half width. For: side-by-side feel without wrap. Against: not asked for; more to test.
C. Free sizing by dragging. Against: hard on touch and keyboard, and becomes presentation data.
fieldValues.key_requirements: No text wrap (owner); full width, original size and alignment (owner); a caption (owner); keyboard and touch usable.
fieldValues.decision_statement: An image paragraph is laid out as full width or original size, aligned left, centre or right at original size, with text never wrapping around it.
fieldValues.rationale: It is the owner's set, held as two small closed fields, and the image is always a block, so layout cannot break the flow of paragraphs.
fieldValues.revisit_when: Writers repeatedly want a size the two options do not give, such as a half-width image.
